mapper.sql: id, customer_id, status, total_cents, currency, version, created_at, updated_at, payment_no, paid_at, payment_expires_at, cancelled_at, cancellation_reason, stock_released, shipping_address_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, shipping_region, shipping_detail

where.if: AND ( LOWER(id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(customer_id) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') OR LOWER(COALESCE(payment_no, '')) LIKE CONCAT('%', LOWER(#{keyword}), '%') )

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO customer_orders ( id, customer_id, status, total_cents, currency, version, created_at, updated_at, payment_no, paid_at, payment_expires_at, cancelled_at, cancellation_reason, stock_released, shipping_address_id, recipient_name, recipient_phone, shipping_region, shipping_detail ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{customerId}, #{status}, #{totalCents}, #{currency}, #{version}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{paymentNo}, #{paidAt}, #{paymentExpiresAt}, #{cancelledAt}, #{cancellationReason}, #{stockReleased}, #{shippingAddressId}, #{recipientName}, #{recipientPhone}, #{shippingRegion}, #{shippingDetail} )
mapper.update: UPDATE customer_orders SET status = #{status}, payment_no = #{paymentNo}, paid_at = #{paidAt}, payment_expires_at = #{paymentExpiresAt}, cancelled_at = #{cancelledAt}, cancellation_reason = #{cancellationReason}, stock_released = #{stockReleased}, shipping_address_id = #{shippingAddressId}, recipient_name = #{recipientName}, recipient_phone = #{recipientPhone}, shipping_region = #{shippingRegion}, shipping_detail = #{shippingDetail}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT id, product_id, sku, product_name, unit_price_cents, quantity FROM order_items WHERE order_id = #{orderId} ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM customer_orders WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM customer_orders WHERE id = #{id} AND customer_id = #{customerId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT FROM customer_orders
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT FROM customer_orders WHERE status = 'CANCELLED' AND stock_released = FALSE AND cancelled_at IS NOT NULL ORDER BY cancelled_at ASC LIMIT #{limit}
